notes.title: Fall Counter and Alternate Music Choices!
notes.content:
New update!

Fall Counter

Added a fall counter which will track whenever you fall:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/2bb35ef0cf6d6e03c49a5729e9f7c7b85d0e2d65.png

It counts whenever you fall for 2~ seconds. It's off by default, turn it on in the settings here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/14b0ce19324609158219dcdb9cfe7faad9fa9e42.png

Simplified/Alt Music Choice

If you are having problems with streaming or hosting sites and don't want to mute the music, then behold! Remade all the music so there will be 0 problems. They are all the same songs just using different instruments and more simplified. You can change it here on the Start screen:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/6d22aef0ddf937ef403d817a6881c5010214d465.png

Also in the settings:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/7d4c1ecd98936966d905f299c8d4bd3842e434ed.png

Not entirely sure which song was causing problems, or if it was an error or what. BUT! Might as well remake them because why not, they mostly use a xylophone.

Anyway you can choose which music you want or just turn it off altogether. It may be on by default or it may not, no one can know for sure.

Use support email if there be any bugs or suggestions or to send pictures of dung beetles.

notes.title: Speedrun Timer Added
notes.content:
Guess what? It's TIME!

"Time??" You ask perplexed but intrigued.

It's time for a speedrun timer to be added.

"Oh I get it!" You exclaim repeatably.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/60da51b986a42c865d7dc2ec6bf4cbada2bfdb7a.png

It's off by default so you gotta toggle it on here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/9482acf9e3d55dbdf191b8fb44528580b6c0bd37.png

It uses delta time, not entirely sure if that's how it do be done but it seems reasonable.

The time stops once you hit the first confetti and it will also keep time when toggled off. Stops at 999:99.

Use Restart in the menu to restart the timer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/86131b65e5e5e4ae38269b9948b26181e9af1a42.png

Also it will save your best time and show it in the corner pause menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/c96a6bea9e55c48748f388b6ee85819cf85c0552.png

Music

Some of the music is saying it isn't royalty free, could just remake them all in FL Studio but it might not sound as majestic. You can turn it off in the audio settings in the meantime:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751167/439f148108c6edaf28e4c72d98f0a20aa9189ed7.png
